record: Nanyue King Museum, official visitor information
facts: The Palace and Garden exhibition site at 316 Zhongshan Fourth Road is a separate venue from the King’s Tomb on Jiefang North Road.

record: Nanyue King Museum description of the Palace Garden Hall
facts: The second level has an open-air leisure and display terrace. The hall protects remains from the historic palace garden.

record: Guangzhou municipal walking guide, Palace Museum route section
facts: The entrance next to Zhongshan Fourth Road leads first to the covered crooked watercourse and its rooftop display; the other halls are separate farther inside.
